description: Parking — Meter locations is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Brisbane City Council Parking Meter Zones operating times, rates and location description including latitude and longitude. Additional information on parking meters including a zone map can be found on the Brisbane City Council website. Brisbane City Council Parking Meter Zones operating times, rates and location description including latitude and longitude. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Parking and Walking. Its keywords are arcgis, parking, roads traffic and parking, spatial data, transport. The portal shows 945 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
